title: SODI Vertical Laptop Stand for Desk, Gravity Auto Lock MacBook Stand, Aluminum Laptop Holder Vertical Compatible with MacBook Pro, Air, Tablet, Space-Saving Organize Work & Home Office, Gray Review
reviews: Saves space and holds my laptop perfectly This is a small but significant part of my WFH setup. Because I use a laptop it sets on my desk and typically takes up a lot of real estate so I was looking for a way to reclaim that space. This laptop stand works perfectly. Its slim enough to be well out of the way, tall and sturdy enough to hold my laptop without any worry of slipping or falling. The hinge at the bottom allows it to fold securely but not crush my laptop. It also allows it to hold larger laptops so its nice if I want to bring my gaming laptop in and setup here as well. The silver fits well with my docking station (not critical but nice none the less). Its nice and light and at a good price so I am very happy.

Good product and sturdy I'm impressed with this device and it's so simple. I have no issues putting my Macbook 15" on it. It's sturdy, closes as you put the MacBook in/on it, and the only thing that touches my PC are the rubber tabs. It takes very little space and stands up straight.
Works Great! Nice for different laptop sizes and models. Balanced perfectly and allows for multiple devices. Nice build quality and attention to detail.

Such simple design and saves desk space I like this laptop stand for my MacBook Air. it gives it room to access the usb ports easily without taking up much desk space. The design is very elegant and simple, no clamps, just place it in and the stand close around the computer. There are side stands to put a tablet of phone, I don't use them much but they are there.

Excellent laptop holder with good design and stability Simple and reliable laptop holder. Stable and sturdy. Get's the job done. The passive wight triggered clamping is an excellent way to secure the laptop. Nice design and a good

Excellent for Macbook Pro 13" (M2) as a vertical stand! It perfectly encompasses a Macbook Pro 13" (2022 - M2) and holds it tightly. I can then plug in a USB-C dock to the top (which charges the MBP and lets me output to my 34" monitor) and leaves 1 USB-C port easily accessible. I use a USB-C earpod for calls, but it works well with USB-C drives. The all metal construction is super sturdy, though it somethings grips on the MBP a bit tightly when you pick it up.
Works great Very sturdy and well made. Holds my 16" HP laptop quite well and stable

Very Nice I really like this stand. It holds my MacBook Pro firm enough to keep it in place yet not too firm to leave marks. Not only does it work, but it really matches the aesthetic of the MacBook. The ledge on the side that can hold your iPhone as well is very nice. Highly recommended product.
